evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Real-world degradations such as blur, shadow, distortion, and moire patterns severely impair the document question-answering capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs).

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Agentic restoration offers new possibilities for automation, yet existing frameworks primarily target natural images and pursue perceptual quality, overlooking that restoration should serve downstream tasks rather than optimize generic image quality metrics.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: A Comparison-Based Rollback mechanism validates each restoration step and reverts it when question-relevant evidence becomes less decipherable.
